title: The Growth Marketing + AI Stack
subtitle: Ten go-to-market folders, first touch to final report. Every item here is built and running today, in whole or in part.

kinds.agent: AI seats that hold a growth role: strategy, media buying, editing, analysis, review.
kinds.skill: Repeatable playbooks an agent loads on demand: voice, video, QR, data rules, audits.
kinds.loop: Scheduled jobs that run daily or weekly with no one pressing a button.
kinds.automation: Always-on systems: AI answering, consent register, cockpit, classroom.

stages.name: Market Research
stages.outcome: Recorded sales calls become a read of objections, strengths and weaknesses.

items.name: Call-based market SWOT
items.outcome: Turns recorded sales calls into a read of objections, strengths and weaknesses per rep

stages.name: Positioning & Offer
stages.outcome: Channel strategy, brand voice and offer tests set before a dollar is spent.

items.name: Growth marketing lead
items.outcome: Plans channel strategy, budget split and offer tests as recommendations; a person applies every change

items.name: Brand voice system
items.outcome: Produces a tone-of-voice and brand guide every content tool follows

items.name: Founder voice transfer
items.outcome: Rewrites drafts so they sound like the founder, with AI tells removed

items.name: Copy variation burst
items.outcome: Writes distinct hooks, headlines and offers to test, not reworded copies

items.name: Short-form strategy playbook
items.outcome: Picks the audience, scores ideas and sets calls to action so reels bring leads, not just views

stages.name: Content Engine
stages.outcome: One sentence in, finished scripts and edited reels out, on brand.

items.name: Viral ad scriptwriter
items.outcome: Turns one sentence into candidate ad scripts (hook, story, call to action), each checked against a claims rulebook before a person approves it

items.name: AI edit crew (seven seats)
items.outcome: Seven seats (editor, transcriber, B-roll researcher, screen editor, sound designer, animator, finisher) take footage from brief to finished vertical and horizontal reels, with a person approving each cut

items.name: Motion engineer
items.outcome: Builds reusable animated reel templates and motion graphics

items.name: Brand video engine
items.outcome: Renders on-brand product and proof reels from real footage

items.name: Shot list director
items.outcome: Plans shoots so every shot has a job in the edit

items.name: Social posting kit
items.outcome: Prepares ready-to-post kits for channels that can't be automated

items.name: Slide and carousel generator
items.outcome: Builds on-brand decks and LinkedIn carousels

items.name: Creative library sync
items.outcome: Pulls every ad from Google, Meta and Microsoft daily, then renders and describes each one so the library can be searched

items.name: Content studio request desk
items.outcome: One studio panel where an idea becomes a ticket, is rendered into on-brand reels and lands in a media library

stages.name: Paid Media
stages.outcome: Every platform's results land daily, and sales flow back so ads optimize for revenue.

items.name: Paid media operator
items.outcome: Audits accounts, pulls performance and drafts changes across Google, YouTube, Meta and Microsoft; a person applies every live change

items.name: Daily ad performance pull
items.outcome: Spend, clicks and conversions from every platform land in one warehouse each morning

items.name: Sending sales back to ad platforms
items.outcome: Each day the ad platforms are told which leads became sales (Google and Meta), so they can optimize for revenue

items.name: Weekly paid hygiene read
items.outcome: Catches waste, broken tracking and policy risk across accounts every week

items.name: Self-serve social link tagging
items.outcome: Social posts logged in a shared sheet get tracked links generated automatically; rows that break the naming rules are refused

items.name: QR campaign builder
items.outcome: Print-ready, scan-verified QR codes for mail, print and events, each one tracked

stages.name: Capture & Consent
stages.outcome: Consents and opt-outs recorded with their exact wording and reconciled nightly.

items.name: Outside consent register
items.outcome: An independent register records consents and opt-outs with their exact wording, seals each entry, reconciles against vendor records nightly and can retrieve the record on request

items.name: Internal do-not-call program
items.outcome: Daily suppression list fed by text and call stop requests, with a nightly audit of the evidence

items.name: Event show calendar sync
items.outcome: Pushes the home-show schedule into the CRM event list automatically

items.name: Shows and events seat
items.outcome: Answers events questions from a show playbook and drafts staffing kits and follow-up plans; recommend-only

stages.name: Speed to Lead
stages.outcome: AI answers after-hours calls and website chats, captures the lead and hands it to a person.

items.name: AI phone answering
items.outcome: Answers after-hours calls, captures the caller's name, address and need, and emails the team a summary the next morning

items.name: Website AI chat
items.outcome: Answers website visitors around the clock, qualifies buyers and emails the team the full conversation for leads and complaints

items.name: After-hours call recovery
items.outcome: Missed after-hours callers are in the team inbox by morning

items.name: AI conversation outlier review
items.outcome: Flags unusual calls and chats every day so the AI keeps improving

items.name: Chat handoff check
items.outcome: Checks hourly that every engaged website chat was handed to a person

items.name: Speed-to-lead weekly
items.outcome: Weekly read of how fast each channel's leads get a first touch

items.name: AI front door weekly
items.outcome: Weekly scorecard for the AI answering lanes

items.name: AI agent KPI report
items.outcome: Weekly results report for the AI phone line: calls, leads and transfers

items.name: Service follow-up check
items.outcome: Checks that every after-hours service call was followed up

stages.name: Sales Floor
stages.outcome: Sales calls pulled, transcribed and scored daily, with training on tap.

items.name: AI call listening
items.outcome: Pulls, transcribes and scores sales calls each day

items.name: Call floor diagnostics
items.outcome: Daily board of dials, connects and set rate by rep

items.name: Training classroom
items.outcome: Self-serve onboarding and product training for the floor

stages.name: Attribution & Cost
stages.outcome: Daily spend recorded and checked against platform controls.

items.name: Cost accuracy crew
items.outcome: Research, report and senior-review seats check each platform's spend inputs and recompute totals before anything is reported

items.name: Marketing efficiency pacing analyst
items.outcome: Tracks spend as a share of revenue by channel and office and warns before a target is missed

items.name: Daily cost sync and gap alert
items.outcome: Every platform's spend is recorded daily and a daily check lists gaps

items.name: Monthly marketing-cost check
items.outcome: Closes each month's marketing cost against revenue, with a month-to-date pull

items.name: Ad call to lead match
items.outcome: Ties every ad-driven phone call to its lead daily

items.name: Contact attribution coverage
items.outcome: Measures daily the share of contacts that carry a known source

items.name: CRM marketing feed and reconcile
items.outcome: Lands CRM lead and sales data daily and reconciles it against ad data

items.name: AI spend meter
items.outcome: Meters what each AI workload costs, with a daily reconciliation that is currently incomplete

stages.name: Reporting Cockpit
stages.outcome: One screen where the numbers refresh themselves.

items.name: ECHO OS cockpit
items.outcome: One command center where marketing, sales and ops numbers live and refresh themselves

items.name: BI workbench
items.outcome: Reports can be pivoted, filtered, drilled into, charted and saved as views

items.name: BI workbench standard
items.outcome: Holds every new report to the interactive standard

items.name: Digital marketing board
items.outcome: In-house ad spend and results by market, platform and campaign, refreshed daily

items.name: Marketing initiatives tracker
items.outcome: Every open initiative, with its owner and status, in the cockpit

items.name: Cockpit chat
items.outcome: Ask questions of the company knowledge base in plain English and get answers with sources

items.name: Self-refreshing reports
items.outcome: Rebuilt hourly, nightly and weekly, with recent days restated as late data lands

items.name: Daily reporting alert
items.outcome: Morning alert when a number is late or looks wrong

items.name: Digital marketing daily record
items.outcome: Logs each day's changes and decisions and rolls them into a Friday report

items.name: Marketing analyst
items.outcome: Builds report packs and answers "what does this number mean"

stages.name: Reliability
stages.outcome: Failures flagged loudly: bounded self-healing, stall alarms and data-gap checks.

items.name: Self-healing
items.outcome: Classifies failed scheduled jobs and re-runs or restarts the fixable ones, up to three tries a day, then hands the rest to a person

items.name: Health and stability census
items.outcome: Peer-reviewed checks that every scheduled job is alive and producing output

items.name: Reporting regression suite
items.outcome: Runs a set of guard tests against the reporting code each day and flags any that fail

items.name: Daily data completeness gate
items.outcome: Checks daily that every reporting table has a row for each expected day and lists each gap

items.name: API rate governor
items.outcome: Keeps every integration under vendor rate limits

items.name: Nightly backup
items.outcome: Every store is backed up each night to a separate disk

items.name: CI pair
items.outcome: Commits finished work and verifies it passes checks and secret scans

items.name: Security reviewer seat
items.outcome: Reviews changes that touch consumer contact or customer data before they ship

items.name: Data classification
items.outcome: Decides which data may go to which AI tool

items.name: Compliance audit
items.outcome: Playbook for a control-mapped gap review against SOC 2, PCI, ISO, privacy and AI rules

items.name: Diagnose
items.outcome: Test-first method for silent failures
